items.note: 象 is しょう here, with a long vowel. 第一印象 = first impression.

examples.ja: 彼女の第一＿はとてもよかった。
examples.full: 彼女の第一印象はとてもよかった。
examples.en: My first impression of her was very good.

mnemonic.meaning: 印 stamp + 象 image: the image stamped on your mind. An impression.
mnemonic.reading: Your first impression happens IN the SHOW (いん・しょう). しょう as in 現象 (phenomenon).

items.note: 記憶 = what you remember. 記録 (きろく) = a written record.

examples.ja: 子どものころの＿は、あまりない。
examples.full: 子どものころの記憶は、あまりない。
examples.en: I don't have many memories from my childhood.

mnemonic.meaning: 記 record + 憶 recollect: something recorded that you recollect. A memory.
mnemonic.reading: You carve a memory into an OAK tree with your KEY (き・おく). き as in 日記 (diary).

items.note: 慌てて = in a hurry, flustered. The opposite is 落ち着く (to calm down).

examples.ja: 地震が起きても、＿必要はない。
examples.full: 地震が起きても、慌てる必要はない。
examples.en: Even if an earthquake happens, there's no need to panic.

mnemonic.meaning: 慌 has 忄 (heart): your heart races. You panic.
mnemonic.reading: "AWW, TERRible, I'm late!" (あわてる) you panic.

items.note: 慎重に = carefully, cautiously. 身長 (also しんちょう) = height.

examples.ja: 大事なことなので、＿に決めたい。
examples.full: 大事なことなので、慎重に決めたい。
examples.en: It's important, so I want to decide carefully.

mnemonic.meaning: 慎 careful + 重 heavy: you handle heavy things carefully. Cautious.
mnemonic.reading: しん + ちょう: 重 is ちょう here, like 貴重 (valuable). You're careful with valuables.

items.note: 信頼する = trust someone. 依頼 (いらい) = a request.

examples.ja: 彼はうそをつかないので、みんなに＿されている。
examples.full: 彼はうそをつかないので、みんなに信頼されている。
examples.en: He never lies, so everyone trusts him.

mnemonic.meaning: 信 trust + 頼 rely: trust you can rely on.
mnemonic.reading: しん as in 信じる (believe) + らい: you trust someone who always does RIGHT (らい).

items.note: 活躍する = be active and successful, in sports or at work.

examples.ja: 彼はチームの中心として＿している。
examples.full: 彼はチームの中心として活躍している。
examples.en: He's playing a big role as the heart of the team.

mnemonic.meaning: 活 active + 躍 leap: actively leaping around. Doing great in a role.
mnemonic.reading: The CATS YAK (かつ・やく) excitedly about the star player. かつ as in 生活 (daily life).

items.note: 興奮する = get excited or worked up.

examples.ja: 試合に勝って、みんな＿していた。
examples.full: 試合に勝って、みんな興奮していた。
examples.en: We won the game and everyone was excited.

mnemonic.meaning: 興 excitement + 奮 stir up: stirred-up excitement.
mnemonic.reading: A KO is FUN (こう・ふん): the crowd gets worked up.

items.note: 後悔する = regret. 航海 (also こうかい) = a sea voyage.

examples.ja: 若いころもっと勉強すればよかったと＿している。
examples.full: 若いころもっと勉強すればよかったと後悔している。
examples.en: I regret not studying more when I was young.

mnemonic.meaning: 後 after + 悔 regret: the regret that comes after.
mnemonic.reading: こう as in 後半 (second half): regret comes in the second half. Same sound as 航海 (voyage).

items.note: 契約する = sign a contract. 約 also appears in 約束, 予約 and 節約.

examples.ja: 新しいアパートの＿にサインした。
examples.full: 新しいアパートの契約にサインした。
examples.en: I signed the contract for my new apartment.

mnemonic.meaning: 契 pledge + 約 promise: a pledged promise. A contract.
mnemonic.reading: KAY signs a contract to buy a YAK (けい・やく). やく as in 約束 and 節約.

items.note: 滞在 = staying somewhere for a while, e.g. on a trip or at a hotel.

examples.ja: 日本には二週間＿する予定だ。
examples.full: 日本には二週間滞在する予定だ。
examples.en: I plan to stay in Japan for two weeks.

mnemonic.meaning: 滞 stay + 在 exist: staying and being present somewhere. A stay.
mnemonic.reading: You TIE (たい) yourself to one place for your stay. 滞 is たい as in 渋滞; ざい as in 現在 (present).

items.note: 到着 = arrival. The opposite is 出発 (しゅっぱつ).

examples.ja: 飛行機は予定より三十分早く＿した。
examples.full: 飛行機は予定より三十分早く到着した。
examples.en: The plane arrived thirty minutes earlier than scheduled.

mnemonic.meaning: 到 arrive + 着 arrive: arrive, twice over. Arrival.
mnemonic.reading: You arrive, CHUCK off your shoes and wiggle your TOEs (とう・ちゃく).

items.note: 徹夜する = stay up all night. 夜 is や here (usually よる).

examples.ja: 試験の前の日に＿して勉強した。
examples.full: 試験の前の日に徹夜して勉強した。
examples.en: I stayed up all night studying the day before the exam.

mnemonic.meaning: 徹 all the way through + 夜 night: through the whole night.
mnemonic.reading: てつ also means iron (鉄): an iron will to stay up all night. や as in 今夜 (tonight).

items.note: Also written 引っ越し. The verb is 引っ越す.

examples.ja: 来月、大阪へ＿することになった。
examples.full: 来月、大阪へ引越しすることになった。
examples.en: It's been decided that I'm moving to Osaka next month.

mnemonic.meaning: 引 pull + 越 cross over: pull your stuff across to a new home.
mnemonic.reading: The HICK loads everything into a COACH (ひっ・こし) and moves. From 引っ越す.

items.note: 眺める = look at something for a while, like a view or the sky.

examples.ja: 窓から海を＿のが好きだ。
examples.full: 窓から海を眺めるのが好きだ。
examples.en: I like looking out at the sea from the window.

mnemonic.meaning: 眺 has 目 (eye): you rest your eyes on the view.
mnemonic.reading: You gaze for a LONG time (長い, なが) at a MARE in the field (なが・める).

items.note: 握る = grip or squeeze. 握手 (あくしゅ) = handshake.

examples.ja: 子どもは母親の手を強く＿。
examples.full: 子どもは母親の手を強く握る。
examples.en: The child grips his mother's hand tightly.

mnemonic.meaning: 握 has the hand radical 扌: grip it with your hand.
mnemonic.reading: Like にぎり sushi, rice squeezed in your hand. You grip with your KNEES (に) riding a horse.

items.note: 〜に頼る = depend on. 頼む (たのむ) = ask someone for something.

examples.ja: 困ったときは、友達に＿。
examples.full: 困ったときは、友達に頼る。
examples.en: When I'm in trouble, I rely on my friends.

mnemonic.meaning: 頼 rely, as in 信頼 (trust): to rely on someone.
mnemonic.reading: You TIE YOUR (たよる) little boat to the big ship. You depend on it.

items.note: 溜まる = something builds up. 溜める = you save it up.

examples.ja: 掃除しないと、部屋にほこりが＿。
examples.full: 掃除しないと、部屋にほこりが溜まる。
examples.en: If you don't clean, dust builds up in the room.

mnemonic.meaning: 溜 has 氵 (water): water pooling up. Things build up.
mnemonic.reading: EGGS (たまご) pile up in the fridge (たま・る).

items.note: 嫌う = dislike (verb). Everyday speech usually says 嫌いだ.

examples.ja: 猫は水を＿。
examples.full: 猫は水を嫌う。
examples.en: Cats dislike water.

mnemonic.meaning: Same kanji as 嫌い (dislike), which you know. This is the verb: to dislike.
mnemonic.reading: Take 嫌い (きらい), drop the い, add う: きらう.

items.note: 一瞬 = an instant. 瞬間 (しゅんかん) = the exact moment something happens.

examples.ja: ＿、何が起きたのかわからなかった。
examples.full: 一瞬、何が起きたのかわからなかった。
examples.en: For a moment, I didn't know what had happened.

mnemonic.meaning: 一 one + 瞬 blink: one blink. An instant.
mnemonic.reading: いち + しゅん squeeze into いっしゅん, like 一緒 (いっしょ).

items.note: 抱える = hold in your arms; also to carry a burden. 問題を抱える = have problems.

examples.ja: 両手で荷物を＿のは大変だ。
examples.full: 両手で荷物を抱えるのは大変だ。
examples.en: Carrying luggage in both arms is hard.

mnemonic.meaning: 抱 is 扌 (hand) + 包 (wrap): wrap something in your arms. You can also hold problems or work.
mnemonic.reading: A kid hugs a big bag of CACAO (かかお) beans in their arms (かか・える).

items.note: 輝く = shine brightly: stars, eyes, a future. 光る (ひかる) = give off light.

examples.ja: 夜空に星が＿。
examples.full: 夜空に星が輝く。
examples.en: Stars shine in the night sky.

mnemonic.meaning: 輝 has 光 (light): giving off light. Shining.
mnemonic.reading: A mirror (かがみ) that YAKs light everywhere (かが・やく): it sparkles.

items.note: 願う = wish or hope. お願いします comes from this verb.

examples.ja: 家族の健康を＿。
examples.full: 家族の健康を願う。
examples.en: I wish for my family's health.

mnemonic.meaning: 願 wish, as in お願いします.
mnemonic.reading: Same as お願い (おねがい): the verb is 願う.

items.note: 戻す = put something back. 戻る (もどる) = come back yourself.

examples.ja: 使ったはさみを引き出しに＿。
examples.full: 使ったはさみを引き出しに戻す。
examples.en: I put the scissors I used back in the drawer.

mnemonic.meaning: 戻 has 戸 (door): put it back behind the door.
mnemonic.reading: もどる (go back) you know. もどす is the one you do to something: put it back.

items.note: 今後 = from now on (a bit formal). 今度 (こんど) = this time or next time.

examples.ja: ＿はもっと気をつけます。
examples.full: 今後はもっと気をつけます。
examples.en: From now on, I'll be more careful.

mnemonic.meaning: 今 now + 後 after: after now. From now on.
mnemonic.reading: こん as in 今度 (next time), ご as in 最後 (last).

items.note: 相当 = considerably, like かなり. It can also mean "equivalent to".

examples.ja: 彼は＿疲れているようだ。
examples.full: 彼は相当疲れているようだ。
examples.en: He seems quite tired.

paraphrase.sentence: 彼は【相当】疲れているようだ。

mnemonic.meaning: 相 mutual + 当 fitting: fitting for the situation, and then some. Considerably.
mnemonic.reading: SO TOO much (そう・とう): considerably. そう as in 相談, とう as in 本当.

items.note: 超える = go over a limit or a number. 越える (same reading) = cross over a place.

examples.ja: 今日の気温は三十五度を＿そうだ。
examples.full: 今日の気温は三十五度を超えるそうだ。
examples.en: They say today's temperature will go over 35 degrees.

mnemonic.meaning: 超 has 走 (run): run beyond the line. Exceed.
mnemonic.reading: Same sound as 越える (cross over): you cross over the limit.

items.note: 確実 = certain, sure. 確実に = definitely.

examples.ja: このままでは、遅刻するのは＿だ。
examples.full: このままでは、遅刻するのは確実だ。
examples.en: At this rate, being late is certain.

mnemonic.meaning: 確 certain + 実 reality: a certain reality. Sure, reliable.
mnemonic.reading: かく as in 確認 (confirm), じつ as in 実は (level 1).

items.note: 当時 = back then, at a specific past time. 同時 (どうじ) = at the same time.

examples.ja: 大学生だった＿、毎日アルバイトをしていた。
examples.full: 大学生だった当時、毎日アルバイトをしていた。
examples.en: Back when I was a university student, I worked part-time every day.

mnemonic.meaning: 当 that + 時 time: that time. Back then.
mnemonic.reading: とう as in 本当, じ as in 時間 (time).

items.note: 成長する = grow up or develop (people, companies, the economy).

examples.ja: 子どもの＿は本当に早い。
examples.full: 子どもの成長は本当に早い。
examples.en: Children grow up so fast.

mnemonic.meaning: 成 become + 長 grow: become grown. Growth.
mnemonic.reading: せい as in 成功 (success), ちょう as in 社長 (company president): the president grows the company.

items.note: 中心 = the middle or core of something. 〜を中心に = centered on.

examples.ja: 駅は町の＿にある。
examples.full: 駅は町の中心にある。
examples.en: The station is in the center of town.

mnemonic.meaning: 中 middle + 心 heart: the heart of the middle. The center.
mnemonic.reading: ちゅう as in 中学 (middle school), しん as in 安心 (relief).

items.meaning: because of (a bad result); due to
items.connection: Plain form (な-adj + な / N + の) + せいで
items.note: せいで blames a cause for a bad result. For good results use おかげで.

examples.ja: 雨の＿、試合が中止になった。
examples.full: 雨のせいで、試合が中止になった。
examples.en: Because of the rain, the game was cancelled.

examples.ja: 隣の部屋がうるさい＿、勉強に集中できない。
examples.full: 隣の部屋がうるさいせいで、勉強に集中できない。
examples.en: Because the next room is noisy, I can't concentrate on studying.

order.en: Because I overslept, I was late for an important meeting.

translate.sentence: 私のせいで、みんなが遅れてしまった。
translate.answer: Because of me, everyone ended up being late.
wrong: Thanks to me, everyone arrived on time.
Everyone was late, but it wasn't my fault.

situation.prompt: You explain that you slept badly because the neighbors were noisy.
situation.sentence: 隣がうるさかった＿、よく眠れなかった。

mnemonic.meaning: "SAY, it's because of YOU!" せいで blames something for a bad result. おかげで thanks, せいで blames.

items.connection: V-dictionary / N + の + たびに
items.note: たびに follows the dictionary form (not the た form), even for past habits.

examples.ja: 母は私に会う＿、「元気？」と聞く。
examples.full: 母は私に会うたびに、「元気？」と聞く。
examples.en: Every time my mother sees me, she asks, "Are you well?"

examples.ja: 会う＿、彼の印象が変わる。
examples.full: 会うたびに、彼の印象が変わる。
examples.en: Every time I meet him, my impression of him changes.

forms.sentence: ＿たびに、写真をたくさん撮る。

order.en: Every time I see him, he's wearing different clothes.

translate.sentence: この写真を見るたびに、祖母を思い出す。
translate.answer: Every time I see this photo, I think of my grandmother.
wrong: When I saw this photo once, I thought of my grandmother.
I look at this photo so that I won't forget my grandmother.

situation.prompt: You say that whenever you go to Kyoto, you visit the same temple.
situation.sentence: 京都へ行く＿、同じお寺に行く。

mnemonic.meaning: Sounds like 旅 (たび, trip): every trip, I get lost. Every time.

items.note: Usually a complaint: someone keeps doing one thing and nothing else.

examples.ja: 弟は毎日ゲームをし＿。
examples.full: 弟は毎日ゲームをしてばかりいる。
examples.en: My little brother does nothing but play games every day.

examples.ja: 彼はいつも慌て＿。
examples.full: 彼はいつも慌ててばかりいる。
examples.en: He's always in a panic.

translate.sentence: 文句を言ってばかりいないで、手伝ってよ。
translate.answer: Stop doing nothing but complain, and help me.
wrong: Don't complain, but you don't have to help.
You only complained once, so please help.

situation.prompt: Your roommate eats snacks all day and does nothing else. You complain to a friend.
situation.sentence: ルームメイトはお菓子を食べ＿。

mnemonic.meaning: ばかり means only. Doing nothing but that one thing is a bit バカ (silly): 遊んでばかりいる.

items.meaning: just as; in the way that
items.connection: V-plain + とおりに / N + の + とおりに (or N + どおりに)
items.note: Do it the way something was said, shown or planned. After a noun it's also written どおりに.

examples.ja: 先生が言った＿、やってみてください。
examples.full: 先生が言ったとおりに、やってみてください。
examples.en: Please try doing it just as the teacher said.

examples.ja: 彼が提案した＿、計画を変えた。
examples.full: 彼が提案したとおりに、計画を変えた。
examples.en: We changed the plan just as he proposed.

order.en: Fold this paper just as I tell you.

translate.sentence: 思ったとおりに、テストは簡単だった。
translate.answer: Just as I thought, the test was easy.
wrong: Contrary to what I thought, the test was hard.
I thought the test would be easy, but it wasn't.

situation.prompt: You followed the recipe exactly and the cake came out well.
situation.sentence: レシピの＿作ったら、おいしくできた。

mnemonic.meaning: 通り is a street: follow the road exactly as it goes. Just as you were told.

items.meaning: while you're at it; on the way
items.connection: V-dictionary / V-た / N + の + ついでに
items.note: Do a second, smaller thing while you're already doing the first.

examples.ja: 買い物の＿、郵便局に寄った。
examples.full: 買い物のついでに、郵便局に寄った。
examples.en: While I was out shopping, I stopped by the post office.

examples.ja: コンビニに行く＿、牛乳を買ってきてくれると助かる。
examples.full: コンビニに行くついでに、牛乳を買ってきてくれると助かる。
examples.en: If you could pick up some milk while you're at the convenience store, that'd help.

forms.sentence: 大阪への＿ついでに、友達に会った。

order.en: While cleaning the room, I wiped the windows too.

translate.sentence: 駅へ行くついでに、この手紙を出してくれない？
translate.answer: Could you mail this letter on your way to the station?
wrong: Could you go to the station instead of mailing this letter?
Because you're going to the station, you can't mail this letter.

situation.prompt: You're going to the store anyway, so you offer to buy your friend a drink too.
situation.sentence: 店に行く＿、飲み物を買ってこようか？

mnemonic.meaning: While you're already out at the store, grab milk too. Two errands, one trip.
